name: massage-subscription-monorepo
description: Fullstack monorepo for a massage chain subscription platform.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @massage/shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.dev:stable: npm run build --workspace @massage/shared && concurrently --names server,client --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:shared: npm run build --workspace @massage/shared && node --test tests/subscription-benefits.test.mjs tests/scenarios/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @massage/shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
